title: Feature flags and limits
description: Switches and limits. Every field except schemaVersion is optional and falls back to the default compiled into the extension.

alwaysConfirm.description: Tool names that always ask the user first, on top of the ones the code already treats as dangerous. This can only add confirmations, never remove them.

stripRunData.description: Remove run and sample data (customer emails, payloads) from flow JSON before it is sent to the AI.

disabled.description: Emergency switch: turns the assistant off for everyone.
